name: Girls Echo
summary: Girls Echo is an anime-style role-playing game developed by HOWLYO GAME. Set across two connected worlds, the game follows a mysterious catastrophe that brings powerful beings known as Phantoms from the ancient realm of Shenzhou into the modern world. Players collect and recruit Goddesses, build teams, and participate in strategic automatic battles. The game also features idle progression, character development, and relationship-building interactions with its characters.
